strings.cin.c4p2.steam.alexei: They’re rigging a tarpaulin for tomorrow. So the Swede sees the coal, but not who shovels it.
strings.cin.c4p2.book.konrad: Page two hundred and twelve. That is all the Russian I know.
strings.cin.c4p2.express.alexei_publish: Tomorrow Stockholm will know what happens at Kordon-17 at 23:40. And Archipov will know who told.
strings.cin.c4p2.express.alexei_protect: No witness at Door East. But tonight Lev sleeps in his own bed.
strings.cin.c4p2.clock.konrad_name: Ilse sleeps among lasts and leather. Hanna knows now whose name I gave.
strings.cin.c4p2.clock.konrad_protect: Ilse sleeps among lasts and leather. Wendt knows my name now.
strings.cin.c4p2.clock.protect: The wagon runs. The card stays with me until nobody has to pay for it any more.
